SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SECRET REPORT
File No.
S. B. REGISTRY
SECTION 4059
Date September 26 1932

Subject (in full) U.L.Kochubey, applicant for position of Police Watchman.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by

With reference to the application for the post of police watchman made by U.L.Kochubey, on whom a report was submitted by this office on September 12, 1932, further information regarding this individual was received by D.S.Tcheremshansky indicating that his correct name is U.L.Mahotin and that he was formerly employed under this name at the Credit Bureau in Vladivostok. It is also said that he left the U.S.S.R. in 1930 in company with a certain Gracheff, manager of the Credit Bureau, and that after their departure articles were published in Vladivostok newspapers to the effect that they had misappropriated the sum of 20,000 Roubles.

On September 22, Kochubey was called to this office and when confronted with the information in our possession, admitted that he had been employed with the Credit Bureau, Vladivostok, under the name of U.L.Mahotin, (his stepfather's name), but that his correct name was U.L.Kochubey; that in 1930 he had fled from the U.S.S.R. to Harbin in company with Gracheff, manager of the Credit Bureau; that upon arrival in Harbin they had changed their names for those of Kochubey and Tumanoff respectively, in order to escape possible detection and extradition to the Soviet authorities. He, however, denied the allegation that they had misappropriated any money in Vladivostok.

While it is difficult to prove or to disprove Kochubey's statement regarding his past, there is no evidence of his being engaged in any undesirable activity in Shanghai, nor has Gracheff, who is employed, under the name of K.A. Tumanoff, with the China Import & Export Lumber Co., Ltd, 1426 Yangtszepoo Road, come to the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with any political activity.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
D.S.

（印：O.C. //C. S.B. 26/9/32）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
秘密报告
档案编号
S. B. 登记处
第 4059 号卷宗
日期：1932年9月26日

事由（全称）：U.L.Kochubey，警员职位申请人。

由 D.S.Prokofiev 撰写 转呈者

关于 U.L.Kochubey 申请警员一职事宜，本处于 1932 年 9 月 12 日曾就此人提交过一份报告。现收到 D.S.Tcheremshansky 提供的进一步信息，指出其真名为 U.L.Mahotin，此前在符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）的信贷局（Credit Bureau）任职时即使用此名。另有说法称，他于 1930 年与该信贷局经理 Gracheff 一同离开苏联，且在他们离境后，符拉迪沃斯托克的报纸上刊登文章，指称他们侵吞了 20,000 卢布。

9 月 22 日，Kochubey 被传唤至本处。当向其出示我们所掌握的信息时，他承认曾在符拉迪沃斯托克信贷局任职，当时使用的名字是 U.L.Mahotin（其继父的姓氏），但其真名为 U.L.Kochubey；1930 年，他与信贷局经理 Gracheff 一同从苏联逃往哈尔滨；抵达哈尔滨后，为了逃避可能的侦查及被引渡给苏维埃当局，他们分别改名为 Kochubey 和 Tumanoff。然而，他否认了在符拉迪沃斯托克侵吞任何款项的指控。

虽然难以证实或证伪 Kochubey 关于其过往经历的陈述，但目前没有证据表明他在上海从事任何不良活动。此外，Gracheff 目前以 K.A. Tumanoff 之名受雇于杨树浦路 1426 号的中国进出口木材有限公司（China Import & Export Lumber Co., Ltd），市政警察并未发现其有任何涉及政治活动的记录。

特务科主管警官。
D.S.

（印：O.C. //C. S.B. 1932年9月26日）
